verification: Expected policy clauses were checked verbatim against the nine supplied synthetic policy files. Questions and answer checks are authored from those clauses, not model output. Not HR-approved legal guidance or a human-reviewed live-answer accuracy study.

Answer patterns and exact cited-clause checks are conservative mechanical contracts, not proof of arbitrary prose accuracy.
Four personal-balance probes have no BM25 source-selection expectation because the missing source is authoritative employee data, not a policy document.
